$$
\begin{aligned}\int \left(-1+x^{2}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x &= \int \left(-1+x^{2}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x \\ &= -\int 1\,\mathrm{d}x+\int x^{2}\,\mathrm{d}x \\ &= -\frac{x^{0+1}}{(0+1)}+\frac{x^{2+1}}{(2+1)}+C \\ &= -x+\frac{x^{3}}{3}+C\end{aligned}
$$

$$
